summary.name: capcap
summary.one_liner: capcap is a native macOS menu bar screenshot tool that captures windows, regions, and scrolling content, with annotation, beautify, pinning, and image-host upload.
use_cases: capture a window or screen region on macOS
capture and stitch a long scrolling page
annotate screenshots with arrows, text, and mosaic
beautify screenshots with background, rounded corners, shadow
upload screenshots to a personal cloud image host for a public link
pin screenshots on screen while working
summary.what_it_does: capcap runs in the macOS menu bar and is triggered by double-tapping Command. It detects windows on hover and supports arbitrary region capture across multiple displays with Retina-resolution output. Scrolling capture stitches continuous content with a live preview, and the result returns to the same editor. The editor offers arrows, numbers, text, mosaic, highlighter and shapes that stay selectable, movable, rotatable and undoable before export. Output goes to clipboard, file, pinned window, or an image host (Tencent COS, Qiniu Kodo, or Aliyun OSS, configured by the user), and it keeps a recent screenshot and color history.
notable: Double-tap Command to start capture from the menu bar
Annotations remain editable (select, move, rotate, recolor, undo) until exported
Scrolling capture with live stitching preview
Built with pure AppKit, no telemetry, no subscription
caveats: Image upload requires the user's own Tencent COS, Qiniu Kodo, or Aliyun OSS account and keys
